Introduction

XD, formerly known as XEED, is a South Korean boy group currently active under their self-established label, XDREAM. The group consists of four members: Doha, Bao, Jaemin, and UO.

Formed under Nature Space, and consisting of four members, they made their debut on December 1, 2022, with the mini album "Dream Land". Just a month after their debut, it was announced that member Roni would be leaving the group for personal reasons. In 2023, two new members, former TST member UO and former TARGET member Shun, were added to the group ahead of their first comeback, "Blue".

It was announced, on March 22, 2024, via their official Fan Cafe that the group would disband, with activities concluding on April 8, 2024. However, the members regrouped and rebranded as XD, officially re-debuting with the single album "Wished" on May 30, 2025. On July 30th, it was announced that member Shun had withdrawn from the group.
